1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 2 independent tumbler drives; each steering gesture advances one fixed pulse and then settles; the seal and precession still set the spatial challenge.
1.natural_language: Use deliberate gripper pulses to place the stable dice. Clamp each while its top face is level and the seal ring is full. The captured top faces must add to the displayed target. Nothing changes while you decide. A bad clamp or incomplete certification ends the attempt.

full.summary: Drag the gripper directly; each deliberate drag update advances one fixed pulse, then settles. Press Space or CLAMP to transfer the aligned die.

simplified.summary: Click a target point for the same inertial gripper; each click advances one fixed pulse, then settles. Press Space or CLAMP to transfer the aligned die. No auto-target or following.
